title: Archer Keep
tagline: Draw the bow, loose the arrow, hold your keep against the orc horde.
description: You are the archer on the wall of a stone keep. Orc warbands march in from the east and you must break them before they break your gate. Drag toward the orc you want, hold to draw, then release: a longer hold flies flatter and faster, and a hit in the head does 1.8× damage. Each wave brings a new enemy, from fast screechers to armoured brutes, flying dragons and an orc warlord. Between waves you spend coin on walls, a cauldron of boiling oil, knight recruits, better bows and new arrows: pierce, fire, frost and bomb. Every run starts with an empty purse, and the shop names the one upgrade that wave needs. A run ends when the gate or your archer falls, and the verdict names what broke it.

desktop: Aim by dragging, hold to draw
Hold to draw, release to loose

touch: Buy in the shop, then tap NEXT WAVE
